email.subject: Polar Co's site has no booking button
email.body:
Hi Luis,

Quick note on Polar Co's website — I checked it out and noticed two things likely costing you jobs: there's no way to book or request service online, and no click-to-call button on mobile, so anyone searching for HVAC help from their phone has to hunt for your number or fill out a slow form instead. The footer's also out of date and hours aren't listed, which adds doubt for first-time visitors.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
